race.comment: JADE TREES (5) was well supported when resuming last time out over 1212m at this track and proved too strong, scoring by a neck. Will be better for that latest run and will be a tough nut to crack again. FANCY SHOULDER (11) has been freshened with 44 days after winning by 2.75 lengths over 1206m at Port Macquarie. Has transferred to the Sally Taylor stable over the break. Kept up to the mark with a subsequent trial win at Coffs Harbour. Will be tuned up for this and is expected to run well. BARELLO (1) turned things around last start and scored by a long neck when he came with a powerful finish over 1400m at Casino. Taking on a better line-up this time but he is good enough to play a major role. AEROFOIL (9) bounced back last start and got the job done by a long neck over 1210m at Port Macquarie. Suitably placed so anticipating another big run.
